name: craft-product-interface
job: Craft one bounded product UI flow with states, accessibility, and verification: direction, build, polish, or review.

inScope: Framing one coherent surface or flow and its primary job
Setting visual/interaction direction or implementing it
Covering states, forms, recovery, responsiveness, and accessibility floors
Verifying with rendered evidence, screenshots, and device checks
outOfScope: Product-wide design systems, brand identity, or formal a11y certification
Pricing, marketing claims, or promotional media
The complete product promise and capability portfolio

inputs: User brief and approved product/commercial/content truth
Rendered product behavior, code, tests, assets, and platform conventions
Baseline accessibility, input, responsiveness, and performance requirements
outputs: Interface Craft Pack with direction thesis and explicit anti-patterns
States, forms, and recovery behavior design
Verification evidence from rendered checks and completion matrix

tools: render environment for the target platform
permissions: write access to the target codebase for build/polish modes

failureSemantics: Never fabricate product behavior, testimonials, prices, entitlements, metrics, compliance, or validation; an unrenderable or unverified flow is not complete, and Review mode stays read-only unless fixing is requested.

outcome.observable: An Interface Craft Pack with a stated direction, covered states and accessibility floors, and rendered verification evidence (screenshots, device checks, tests) for the declared surface or flow.
